findings.site: aisef/control/gate.py::evaluate — the TDD check's final branch
findings.statement: Two checks read the SAME evidence. When the nop control could not run, `tests verify story` correctly reported UNRUNNABLE (owner ENVIRONMENT) while `TDD` reported FAILED ("tests green on first run — not proven to verify anything"). `_absent_stages` returns nothing as soon as any check FAILED, so the attempt was routed to the developer: the quality budget was charged, no stage was re-run, and the story terminated as QUALITY_BLOCK.
findings.measured: TDD-POLICY-V2-CONFORMANCE.json scenarios G and H on tree 42a29853: check outcome UNRUNNABLE, every blocking row owner=ENVIRONMENT, developer sessions 2, quality attempts 2, terminal QUALITY_BLOCK. The PLAN owner IS routed correctly in the same suite (scenarios B and J: terminal PLAN_CONFLICT, 1 developer session, no retry spent)
findings.impact_in_this_run: none on correctness — fail-closed, 0 false PASS; costs one developer retry and mislabels the terminal
findings.worst_case: a story blocked by an environment that cannot answer is reported as a developer quality failure, and one retry of the model's budget is spent on a condition no code change can fix
findings.why_not_fixed_now: the owner decision of 2026-09-20 specifies retry routing for the PLAN owner only (section 12: 'Do not spend developer retry budget on a planning contradiction'). Routing the ENVIRONMENT owner is an extension of the approved semantics, not a defect against them, and the behaviour predates policy V2 — V2 only gave the condition a name. Section 22 asks for no scope creep; the kernel is frozen for qualification
findings.disposition: FIXED in this cycle; the product tree changes, so mutation, fault matrix, suite, ruff, CI and the full 100 000-trace Phase 12 all re-run on the new kernel
findings.severity_history: opened P2 on 2026-09-20 on the reasoning that the decision's section 12 named only the PLAN owner and that the behaviour predated policy V2. The owner rejected both: the approved routing contract requires UNRUNNABLE evidence to retry the stage and never to consume developer quality retries, and age is irrelevant to severity. Re-measured as a lifecycle defect and raised to P1.

findings.fix: aisef/control/gate.py::evaluate — when no red run was recorded AND the nop control is UNRUNNABLE, the TDD check is UNRUNNABLE with the control's own reason instead of FAILED. One branch; the kernel's existing stage routing (_absent_stages -> _stage_of -> bounded re-verify -> ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE) then applies, which is why lint, review and security never had the defect.
findings.invariant: INV-ABSENCE-NEVER-A-DEVELOPER-FAILURE (new, P1): no gate check may report FAILED for evidence that did not execute; only a check that FAILED on evidence that did execute may charge the developer's quality budget.
